title: One Hour on the Ridge Is a WEEK Down Here
description:
In this town, an hour at the top of the chairlift is a week down at the lake. People ride up to skip the winters and the waiting, and from the deck you can see them on the ridge, standing still for days.

I've never been up. Gran goes up every morning with a blanket big enough for two, and comes down for Sunday dinner to tell me I look older. Then one Sunday she didn't come down.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: What would you ride up the ridge for an hour to skip?
